description: This file contains unit tests for the SharedStorage and related components in a C++ project, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests various functionalities such as setting, getting, deleting values, and managing storage limits via JSONRPC and COMRPC interfaces, including notification handling and scope-specific operations.
